title: BUFFER than Duo
author: Takahiro  T.
desc:
Are you the average gym-rat ? Are you stuck on a plateu? Do you feel intimidated by the looming presence of this language-crazy night bird? Are fed-up how he is buffer than you? Say no more, brother.
You need to change something ASAP!

A 4-day split created for the intermediate gym-rat to MOGG him off of this planet.

Training is focused on getting humongous treetrunks. Massive legs = massive testosterone. The upper body also gets attention and a lot of isolation work. The core, forearms and neck also gets some elevated volume to drive growth.

Read the instructions on the training days. They give you clues how much effort you need to push each set.

So give this program a go and get huge, brother.

ss.note: Add constant weight if you reach the upper end of the rep-range and push close to failure. If you're insane just drop the weight after reaching failure and do a couple more reps until true failure.
Lock the elbows and try to keep a solid form. Focus on the squeezing and lengthening part.
Push it close to failure. Ask for a spot if needed. Don't be shy.
Yeah, put some shades on and curl like the king you are. Use some body-language at the last few reps if needed.
The best machine, hands down! Go heavy and keep constant control of the weight during this lift. Feel the stretch and engage the squeeze. Let's go!
Let's go with moderate intensity and finish off the mid-back. Stretch you scaps and finish strong.

If you have a harness then do them at the cable station.
If not, no problem. Take a bench, a towel and a plate and just bang 12 to 15 reps. Take your time and feel each rep.

If you have a harness then do them at the cable station.
If not, no problem. Take a bench, a towel and a plate and just bang 12 to 15 reps. Take your time and feel each rep.

ex.note: Abs are made in the kitchen? Nope, the are revealed there. You gotta pump them till they are cramping. Heavy duty style.

ss.note:
Leg Day! Heavy duty squats. Close to failure.
Lightweight baby!
Superset with the weight from Hack Squat. Add or subtract weight if needed
Moderate to slightly heavy weight. Keep a solid form and feel the stretch. Use lifting-straps!
Give them some love! The girls love big, girthy and veiny forearms

Welcome to the fun part.
Listen carefully: do one set of extension with moderate intensity and immediately after do the bodyweight sissy squats. Belive me, if this doesn't grow your legs, nothing will
Explained above. 👆
Yup, the bad-girl machine. You gotta do them. Slow and controlled.
Oh yeah. The good-girls machine. Do them slow and controlled and you gonna have legs like Tom Platz in no time!

ex.note: Pray to the Gainz-Goddes for abs like soap bars, brother. PRAY

Increase the weight if you only reach the top end of the rep range. Deep as possible and comfortable.
Take care of your shoulders and listen to your body, blud.
Curl yourself to perfection and pump up your guns
Develop some cannonball-delts, brother. Set the cable-pulley to the hight of your hips and feel the stretch.
Pump up your pecs and show Duo who has the biggest bird-chest!

If you have a harness then do them at the cable station.
If not, no problem. Take a bench, a towel and a plate and just bang 12 to 15 reps. Take your time and feel each rep.

If you have a harness then do them at the cable station.
If not, no problem. Take a bench, a towel and a plate and just bang 12 to 15 reps. Take your time and feel each rep.
As always, pray to them and chant: "Big Gainz! Big Gainz! Big Gainz!"
Starting strong! Heavy duty and no mercy!
Stand on a platform, take a Dumbell in one hand and stabilize yourself with the other and do some quality reps.
Slow and steady. Leave some reps in the tank. About 2-3.
Grow them. Girls love big, girthy and veiny forearms.
Listen carefully: after each leg curl set you do some Bulgarian Split Squats. If you're brave take a dumbell.
Instructions above 👆
You know what to do...😏
Slow and steady. Feel the burn.
Add constant weight if you reach the upper end of the rep-range and push close to failure. If you're insane just drop the weight after reaching failure and do a couple more reps until true failure.
Lock the elbows and try to keep a solid form. Focus on the squeezing and lengthening part.
Push it close to failure. Ask for a spot if needed. Don't be shy.
Yeah, put some shades on and curl like the king you are. Use some body-language at the last few reps if needed.
The best machine, hands down! Go heavy and keep constant control of the weight during this lift. Feel the stretch and engage the squeeze. Let's go!
Let's go with moderate intensity and finish off the mid-back. Stretch you scaps and finish strong.

If not, no problem. Take a bench, a towel and a plate and just bang 12 to 15 reps. Take your time and feel each rep.
